verses.original: דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיְהִ֥י אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh way·hî ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Now the word of the LORD came to me saying

verses.original: הָלֹ֡ךְ וְקָֽרָאתָ֩ בְאָזְנֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה לֵאמֹ֗ר זָכַ֤רְתִּי לָךְ֙ חֶ֣סֶד נְעוּרַ֔יִךְ אַהֲבַ֖ת כְּלוּלֹתָ֑יִךְ לֶכְתֵּ֤ךְ אַחֲרַי֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר בְּאֶ֖רֶץ לֹ֥א זְרוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·lōḵ wə·qā·rā·ṯā ḇə·’ā·zə·nê yə·rū·šā·lim kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh lê·mōr zā·ḵar·tî lāḵ ḥe·seḏ nə·‘ū·ra·yiḵ ’a·hă·ḇaṯ kə·lū·lō·ṯā·yiḵ leḵ·têḵ ’a·ḥă·ray bam·miḏ·bār bə·’e·reṣ lō zə·rū·‘āh
verses.literal: Go and proclaim in the hearing of Jerusalem that this is what . . . the LORD says I remember the devotion of your youth your love as a bride how you followed Me . . . in the wilderness in a land not sown

verses.original: יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ קֹ֤דֶשׁ לַיהוָ֔ה רֵאשִׁ֖ית תְּבוּאָתֹ֑ה כָּל־ אֹכְלָ֣יו יֶאְשָׁ֔מוּ רָעָ֛ה תָּבֹ֥א אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: yiś·rā·’êl qō·ḏeš Yah·weh rê·šîṯ tə·ḇū·ʾå̄·ṯōh kāl- ’ō·ḵə·lāw ye’·šā·mū rā·‘āh tā·ḇō ’ă·lê·hem nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Israel was holy to the LORD the firstfruits of His harvest All who devoured her were found guilty disaster came upon them declares the LORD

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְכָֽל־ מִשְׁפְּח֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh bêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·ḵāl miš·pə·ḥō·wṯ bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Hear the word of the LORD O house of Jacob and all you families of the house of Israel

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ יְהוָ֗ה אָמַ֣ר מַה־ עָ֔וֶל אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֥ם מָּצְא֨וּ בִּי֙ כִּ֥י רָחֲק֖וּ מֵעָלָ֑י וַיֵּֽלְכ֛וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י הַהֶ֖בֶל וַיֶּהְבָּֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar mah- ‘ā·wel ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem mā·ṣə·’ū bî kî rā·ḥă·qū mê·‘ā·lāy way·yê·lə·ḵū ’a·ḥă·rê ha·he·ḇel way·yeh·bā·lū
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says What fault did your fathers find in Me that they strayed so far from Me They followed . . . worthless idols and became worthless themselves

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א אָמְר֔וּ אַיֵּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הַמַּעֲלֶ֥ה אֹתָ֖נוּ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הַמּוֹלִ֨יךְ אֹתָ֜נוּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֗ר בְּאֶ֨רֶץ עֲרָבָ֤ה וְשׁוּחָה֙ בְּאֶ֙רֶץ֙ צִיָּ֣ה וְצַלְמָ֔וֶת בְּאֶ֗רֶץ לֹֽא־ אִ֔ישׁ עָ֤בַר בָּהּ֙ שָֽׁם׃ וְלֹֽא־ אָדָ֖ם יָשַׁ֥ב
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ’ā·mə·rū ’ay·yêh Yah·weh ham·ma·‘ă·leh ’ō·ṯā·nū mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ham·mō·w·lîḵ ’ō·ṯā·nū bam·miḏ·bār bə·’e·reṣ ‘ă·rā·ḇāh wə·šū·ḥāh bə·’e·reṣ ṣî·yāh wə·ṣal·mā·weṯ bə·’e·reṣ lō- ’îš ‘ā·ḇar bāh šām wə·lō- ’ā·ḏām yā·šaḇ
verses.literal: They did not ask Where is the LORD who brought us up from the land of Egypt who led us through the wilderness through a land of deserts and pits a land of drought and darkness a land where no one travels and no one lives

verses.original: וָאָבִ֤יא אֶתְכֶם֙ אֶל־ הַכַּרְמֶ֔ל אֶ֣רֶץ לֶאֱכֹ֥ל פִּרְיָ֖הּ וְטוּבָ֑הּ וַתָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ וַתְּטַמְּא֣וּ אֶת־ אַרְצִ֔י שַׂמְתֶּ֖ם וְנַחֲלָתִ֥י לְתוֹעֵבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ā·ḇî ’eṯ·ḵem ’el- hak·kar·mel ’e·reṣ le·’ĕ·ḵōl pir·yāh wə·ṭū·ḇāh wat·tā·ḇō·’ū wat·tə·ṭam·mə·’ū ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣî śam·tem wə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯî lə·ṯō·w·‘ê·ḇāh
verses.literal: I brought you into a fertile land to eat its fruit and bounty but you came and defiled - My land and made My inheritance detestable

verses.original: הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים לֹ֤א אָֽמְרוּ֙ אַיֵּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה וְתֹפְשֵׂ֤י הַתּוֹרָה֙ לֹ֣א יְדָע֔וּנִי וְהָרֹעִ֖ים פָּ֣שְׁעוּ בִ֑י וְהַנְּבִיאִים֙ נִבְּא֣וּ בַבַּ֔עַל וְאַחֲרֵ֥י הָלָֽכוּ׃ לֹֽא־ יוֹעִ֖לוּ
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hă·nîm lō ’ā·mə·rū ’ay·yêh Yah·weh wə·ṯō·p̄ə·śê hat·tō·w·rāh lō yə·ḏā·‘ū·nî wə·hā·rō·‘îm pā·šə·‘ū ḇî wə·han·nə·ḇî·’îm nib·bə·’ū ḇab·ba·‘al wə·’a·ḥă·rê hā·lā·ḵū lō- yō·w·‘i·lū
verses.literal: The priests did not ask Where is the LORD The experts in the law no longer knew Me and the leaders rebelled against Me The prophets prophesied by Baal and followed . . . useless idols

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן אָרִ֥יב אִתְּכֶ֖ם עֹ֛ד נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה אָרִֽיב׃ וְאֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י בְנֵיכֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ā·rîḇ ’it·tə·ḵem ‘ōḏ nə·’um- Yah·weh ’ā·rîḇ wə·’eṯ- bə·nê ḇə·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: Therefore I will contend with you again declares the LORD and I will bring a case against your children’s children

verses.original: כִּ֣י עִבְר֞וּ אִיֵּ֤י כִתִּיִּים֙ וּרְא֔וּ שִׁלְח֥וּ וְקֵדָ֛ר וְהִֽתְבּוֹנְנ֖וּ מְאֹ֑ד וּרְא֕וּ הֵ֥ן הָיְתָ֖ה כָּזֹֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘iḇ·rū ’î·yê ḵit·tî·yîm ū·rə·’ū šil·ḥū wə·qê·ḏār wə·hiṯ·bō·wn·nū mə·’ōḏ ū·rə·’ū hên hā·yə·ṯāh kā·zōṯ
verses.literal: - Cross over to the coasts of Cyprus and take a look send to Kedar and consider carefully see if there has ever been anything like this

verses.original: גּוֹי֙ הַהֵימִ֥יר אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְהֵ֖מָּה לֹ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעַמִּ֛י הֵמִ֥יר כְּבוֹד֖וֹ בְּל֥וֹא יוֹעִֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: gō·w ha·hê·mîr ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·hêm·māh lō ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·‘am·mî hê·mîr kə·ḇō·w·ḏōw bə·lō·w yō·w·‘îl
verses.literal: Has a nation ever changed its gods Yet they [are] not gods [at all] But My people have exchanged their Glory for useless idols

verses.original: שֹׁ֥מּוּ עַל־ זֹ֑את שָׁמַ֖יִם וְשַׂעֲר֛וּ מְאֹ֖ד חָרְב֥וּ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šōm·mū ‘al- zōṯ šā·ma·yim wə·śa·‘ă·rū mə·’ōḏ ḥā·rə·ḇū nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Be stunned by this O heavens be shocked and utterly appalled declares the LORD

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עַמִּ֑י אֹתִ֨י עָשָׂ֣ה שְׁתַּ֥יִם רָע֖וֹת עָזְב֜וּ מְק֣וֹר׀ חַיִּ֗ים מַ֣יִם לַחְצֹ֤ב לָהֶם֙ בֹּאר֔וֹת נִשְׁבָּרִ֔ים בֹּארֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ יָכִ֖לוּ הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘am·mî ’ō·ṯî ‘ā·śāh šə·ta·yim rā·‘ō·wṯ ‘ā·zə·ḇū mə·qō·wr ḥay·yîm ma·yim laḥ·ṣōḇ lā·hem bō·rō·wṯ niš·bā·rîm bō·rōṯ ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḵi·lū ham·mā·yim
verses.literal: For My people - have committed two evils They have forsaken Me the fountain of living water and they have dug their own cisterns broken cisterns that cannot hold water

verses.original: יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִם־ הַעֶ֙בֶד֙ ה֑וּא יְלִ֥יד בַּ֖יִת מַדּ֖וּעַ הָיָ֥ה לָבַֽז׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·rā·’êl ’im- ha·‘e·ḇeḏ hū yə·lîḏ ba·yiṯ mad·dū·a‘ hā·yāh lā·ḇaz
verses.literal: Is Israel . . . a slave Was he born into slavery . . . Why then has he become prey

verses.original: כְפִרִ֔ים יִשְׁאֲג֣וּ עָלָיו֙ נָתְנ֖וּ קוֹלָ֑ם וַיָּשִׁ֤יתוּ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה אַרְצוֹ֙ עָרָ֥יו נִצְּתָה מִבְּלִ֥י יֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: ḵə·p̄i·rîm yiš·’ă·ḡū ‘ā·lāw nā·ṯə·nū qō·w·lām way·yā·šî·ṯū lə·šam·māh ’ar·ṣōw ‘ā·rāw niṣ·ṣə·ṯå̄h mib·bə·lî yō·šêḇ
verses.literal: The young lions have roared at him they have sounded their voices They have laid waste his land his cities lie in ruins without inhabitant

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ נֹ֖ף וְתַחְפְּנֵס גַּם־ יִרְע֖וּךְ קָדְקֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- nōp̄ wə·ṯaḥ·pə·nēs gam- yir·‘ūḵ qā·ḏə·qōḏ
verses.literal: The men of Memphis and Tahpanhes - have shaved the crown of your head

verses.original: הֲלוֹא־ תַּעֲשֶׂה־ זֹ֖את לָּ֑ךְ עָזְבֵךְ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֔יִךְ בְּעֵ֖ת מוֹלִיכֵ֥ךְ בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w- ta·‘ă·śeh- zōṯ lāḵ ‘ā·zə·ḇêḵ ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·ha·yiḵ bə·‘êṯ mō·w·lî·ḵêḵ bad·dā·reḵ
verses.literal: Have you not brought this on yourself by forsaking - the LORD your God when He led you in the way

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה מַה־ לָּךְ֙ לְדֶ֣רֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִשְׁתּ֖וֹת מֵ֣י שִׁח֑וֹר וּמַה־ לָּךְ֙ לְדֶ֣רֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר לִשְׁתּ֖וֹת מֵ֥י נָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh mah- lāḵ lə·ḏe·reḵ miṣ·ra·yim liš·tō·wṯ mê ši·ḥō·wr ū·mah- lāḵ lə·ḏe·reḵ ’aš·šūr liš·tō·wṯ mê nā·hār
verses.literal: Now what will you gain on your way to Egypt to drink the waters of the Nile What will you gain on your way to Assyria to drink the waters of the Euphrates

verses.original: רָעָתֵ֗ךְ תְּיַסְּרֵ֣ךְ וּמְשֻֽׁבוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ תּוֹכִחֻ֔ךְ וּדְעִ֤י וּרְאִי֙ כִּי־ רַ֣ע וָמָ֔ר עָזְבֵ֖ךְ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יִךְ אֵלַ֔יִךְ וְלֹ֤א פַחְדָּתִי֙ נְאֻם־ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: rā·‘ā·ṯêḵ tə·yas·sə·rêḵ ū·mə·šu·ḇō·w·ṯa·yiḵ tō·w·ḵi·ḥuḵ ū·ḏə·‘î ū·rə·’î kî- ra‘ wā·mār ‘ā·zə·ḇêḵ ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hā·yiḵ ’ê·la·yiḵ wə·lō p̄aḥ·dā·ṯî nə·’um- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Your own evil will discipline you your own apostasies will reprimand you Consider and realize how evil and bitter it is for you to forsake - the LORD your God and to have no fear of Me declares the Lord GOD of Hosts

verses.original: כִּ֣י מֵעוֹלָ֞ם שָׁבַ֣רְתִּי עֻלֵּ֗ךְ נִתַּ֙קְתִּי֙ מוֹסְרֹתַ֔יִךְ וַתֹּאמְרִ֖י לֹ֣א אֶעֱבֹד כִּ֣י עַֽל־ כָּל־ גְּבֹהָ֗ה גִּבְעָ֞ה וְתַ֙חַת֙ כָּל־ רַעֲנָ֔ן עֵ֣ץ אַ֖תְּ צֹעָ֥ה זֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî mê·‘ō·w·lām šā·ḇar·tî ‘ul·lêḵ nit·taq·tî mō·ws·rō·ṯa·yiḵ wat·tō·mə·rî lō ʾɛ·ʿɛ̆·ḇōḏ kî ‘al- kāl- gə·ḇō·hāh giḇ·‘āh wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ kāl- ra·‘ă·nān ‘êṣ ’at ṣō·‘āh zō·nāh
verses.literal: For long ago you broke your yoke and tore off your chains saying I will not serve Indeed on every high hill and under every green tree you lay down as a prostitute

verses.original: וְאָֽנֹכִי֙ נְטַעְתִּ֣יךְ כֻּלֹּ֖ה שֹׂרֵ֔ק אֱמֶ֑ת זֶ֣רַע וְאֵיךְ֙ נֶהְפַּ֣כְתְּ לִ֔י סוּרֵ֖י נָכְרִיָּֽה׃ הַגֶּ֥פֶן
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·nō·ḵî nə·ṭa‘·tîḵ kul·lōh śō·rêq ’ĕ·meṯ ze·ra‘ wə·’êḵ neh·paḵt lî sū·rê nā·ḵə·rî·yāh hag·ge·p̄en
verses.literal: I had planted you like a choice vine from the very best seed How could you turn yourself before Me into a rotten wild vine

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִם־ תְּכַבְּסִי֙ בַּנֶּ֔תֶר וְתַרְבִּי־ לָ֖ךְ בֹּרִ֑ית נִכְתָּ֤ם עֲוֺנֵךְ֙ לְפָנַ֔י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- tə·ḵab·bə·sî ban·ne·ṯer wə·ṯar·bî- lāḵ bō·rîṯ niḵ·tām ‘ă·wō·nêḵ lə·p̄ā·nay nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Although . . . you wash with lye and use an abundance of soap the stain of your guilt is still before Me declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: אֵ֣יךְ תֹּאמְרִ֞י לֹ֣א נִטְמֵ֗אתִי לֹ֣א הָלַ֔כְתִּי אַחֲרֵ֤י הַבְּעָלִים֙ רְאִ֤י דַרְכֵּךְ֙ בַּגַּ֔יְא דְּעִ֖י מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֑ית קַלָּ֖ה בִּכְרָ֥ה מְשָׂרֶ֥כֶת דְּרָכֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’êḵ tō·mə·rî lō niṭ·mê·ṯî lō hā·laḵ·tî ’a·ḥă·rê hab·bə·‘ā·lîm rə·’î ḏar·kêḵ bag·gay də·‘î meh ‘ā·śîṯ qal·lāh biḵ·rāh mə·śā·re·ḵeṯ də·rā·ḵe·hā
verses.literal: How can you say I am not defiled I have not run after the Baals Look at your behavior in the valley acknowledge what you have done You are a swift young she-camel galloping here and there . . .

verses.original: פֶּ֣רֶה׀ לִמֻּ֣ד מִדְבָּ֗ר שָׁאֲפָ֣ה ר֔וּחַ תַּאֲנָתָ֖הּ נַפְשׁוֹ בְּאַוַּ֤ת מִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶ֑נָּה כָּל־ מְבַקְשֶׁ֙יהָ֙ לֹ֣א יִיעָ֔פוּ בְּחָדְשָׁ֖הּ יִמְצָאֽוּנְהָ׃
verses.transliteration: pe·reh lim·muḏ miḏ·bār šā·’ă·p̄āh rū·aḥ ta·’ă·nā·ṯāh nap̄·šō bə·’aw·waṯ mî yə·šî·ḇen·nāh kāl- mə·ḇaq·še·hā lō yî·‘ā·p̄ū bə·ḥā·ḏə·šāh yim·ṣā·’ū·nə·hā
verses.literal: a wild donkey at home in the wilderness sniffing the wind in the heat of her desire Who can restrain her passion All who seek her need not weary themselves in mating season they will find her

verses.original: מִנְעִ֤י רַגְלֵךְ֙ מִיָּחֵ֔ף וְגוֹרְנֵךְ מִצִּמְאָ֑ה וַתֹּאמְרִ֣י נוֹאָ֔שׁ ל֕וֹא כִּֽי־ אָהַ֥בְתִּי זָרִ֖ים וְאַחֲרֵיהֶ֥ם אֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: min·‘î raḡ·lêḵ mî·yā·ḥêp̄ wə·ḡō·rə·nēḵ miṣ·ṣim·’āh wat·tō·mə·rî nō·w·’āš lō·w kî- ’ā·haḇ·tî zā·rîm wə·’a·ḥă·rê·hem ’ê·lêḵ
verses.literal: You should have kept your feet from going bare and your throat from being thirsty But you said It is hopeless . . . For I love foreign [gods] and I must go after them

verses.original: גַּנָּב֙ כְּבֹ֤שֶׁת כִּ֣י יִמָּצֵ֔א כֵּ֥ן בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֹבִ֖ישׁוּ הֵ֤מָּה מַלְכֵיהֶם֙ שָֽׂרֵיהֶ֔ם וְכֹהֲנֵיהֶ֖ם וּנְבִיאֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: gan·nāḇ kə·ḇō·šeṯ kî yim·mā·ṣê kên bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl hō·ḇî·šū hêm·māh mal·ḵê·hem śā·rê·hem wə·ḵō·hă·nê·hem ū·nə·ḇî·’ê·hem
verses.literal: As the thief is ashamed when he is caught so the house of Israel is disgraced They their kings their officials their priests and their prophets

verses.original: אֹמְרִ֨ים לָעֵ֜ץ אַ֗תָּה אָ֣בִי וְלָאֶ֙בֶן֙ אַ֣תְּ יְלִדְתִּנִי כִּֽי־ פָנ֥וּ עֹ֖רֶף אֵלַ֛י וְלֹ֣א פָנִ֑ים וּבְעֵ֤ת רָֽעָתָם֙ יֹֽאמְר֔וּ ק֖וּמָה וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·mə·rîm lā·‘êṣ ’at·tāh ’ā·ḇî wə·lā·’e·ḇen ’at yə·liḏ·ti·nī kî- p̄ā·nū ‘ō·rep̄ ’ê·lay wə·lō p̄ā·nîm ū·ḇə·‘êṯ rā·‘ā·ṯām yō·mə·rū qū·māh wə·hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nū
verses.literal: say to a tree You are my father and to a stone You gave me birth - They have turned their backs to Me and not their faces Yet in the time of trouble they say Rise up and save us

verses.original: וְאַיֵּ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֣יתָ לָּ֔ךְ יָק֕וּמוּ בְּעֵ֣ת רָעָתֶ֑ךָ יוֹשִׁיע֖וּךָ אִם־ כִּ֚י אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ הָי֥וּ מִסְפַּ֣ר עָרֶ֔יךָ יְהוּדָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’ay·yêh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯā lāḵ yā·qū·mū bə·‘êṯ rā·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā yō·wō·šî·‘ū·ḵā ’im- kî ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā hā·yū mis·par ‘ā·re·ḵā yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: But where are the gods - you made for yourselves Let them rise up in your time of trouble and save you if they can for your gods are as numerous as your cities O Judah

verses.original: לָ֥מָּה תָרִ֖יבוּ אֵלָ֑י כֻּלְּכֶ֛ם פְּשַׁעְתֶּ֥ם בִּ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh ṯā·rî·ḇū ’ê·lāy kul·lə·ḵem pə·ša‘·tem bî nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Why do you bring a case against Me You have all rebelled against Me declares the LORD

verses.original: הִכֵּ֣יתִי אֶת־ בְּנֵיכֶ֔ם לַשָּׁוְא֙ לָקָ֑חוּ לֹ֣א מוּסָ֖ר חַרְבְּכֶ֛ם אָכְלָ֧ה נְבִֽיאֵיכֶ֖ם מַשְׁחִֽית׃ כְּאַרְיֵ֥ה
verses.transliteration: hik·kê·ṯî ’eṯ- bə·nê·ḵem laš·šāw lā·qā·ḥū lō mū·sār ḥar·bə·ḵem ’ā·ḵə·lāh nə·ḇî·’ê·ḵem maš·ḥîṯ kə·’ar·yêh
verses.literal: I have struck - your sons in vain they accepted no discipline Your own sword has devoured your prophets like a voracious lion

verses.original: אַתֶּם֙ הַדּ֗וֹר רְא֣וּ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה הָיִ֙יתִי֙ הֲמִדְבָּ֤ר לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֛ם אֶ֥רֶץ מַאְפֵּ֖לְיָ֑ה מַדּ֜וּעַ עַמִּי֙ אָמְר֤וּ רַ֔דְנוּ לֽוֹא־ נָב֥וֹא אֵלֶֽיךָ׃ ע֖וֹד
verses.transliteration: ’at·tem had·dō·wr rə·’ū ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh hā·yî·ṯî hă·miḏ·bār lə·yiś·rā·’êl ’im ’e·reṣ ma’·pê·lə·yāh mad·dū·a‘ ‘am·mî ’ā·mə·rū raḏ·nū lō·w- nā·ḇō·w ’ê·le·ḵā ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: You [people] of this generation consider the word of the LORD Have I been a wilderness to Israel or a land of dense darkness Why do My people say We [are free to] roam we will come to You no more

verses.original: בְּתוּלָה֙ הֲתִשְׁכַּ֤ח עֶדְיָ֔הּ כַּלָּ֖ה קִשֻּׁרֶ֑יהָ וְעַמִּ֣י שְׁכֵח֔וּנִי יָמִ֖ים אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṯū·lāh hă·ṯiš·kaḥ ‘eḏ·yāh kal·lāh qiš·šu·re·hā wə·‘am·mî šə·ḵê·ḥū·nî yā·mîm ’ên mis·pār
verses.literal: Does a maiden forget her jewelry or a bride her wedding sash Yet My people have forgotten Me for days without number

verses.original: מַה־ תֵּיטִ֥בִי דַּרְכֵּ֖ךְ לְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אַהֲבָ֑ה לָכֵן֙ גַּ֣ם אֶת־ הָרָע֔וֹת לִמַּדְתִּי אֶת־ דְּרָכָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: mah- tê·ṭi·ḇî dar·kêḵ lə·ḇaq·qêš ’a·hă·ḇāh lā·ḵên gam ’eṯ- hā·rā·‘ō·wṯ lim·maḏ·tī ’eṯ- də·rā·ḵā·yiḵ
verses.literal: How skillfully . . . you pursue love . . . Even - the most immoral of women could learn - from your ways

verses.original: גַּ֤ם בִּכְנָפַ֙יִךְ֙ נִמְצְא֔וּ דַּ֛ם נַפְשׁ֥וֹת נְקִיִּ֑ים אֶבְיוֹנִ֖ים לֹֽא־ מְצָאתִ֖ים בַמַּחְתֶּ֥רֶת כִּ֥י עַל־ כָּל־ אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: gam biḵ·nā·p̄a·yiḵ nim·ṣə·’ū dam nap̄·šō·wṯ nə·qî·yîm ’eḇ·yō·w·nîm lō- mə·ṣā·ṯîm ḇam·maḥ·te·reṯ kî ‘al- kāl- ’êl·leh
verses.literal: Moreover your skirts are stained with the blood . . . of the innocent poor though you did not find them breaking in But in spite of all these things

verses.original: וַתֹּֽאמְרִי֙ כִּ֣י נִקֵּ֔יתִי אַ֛ךְ אַפּ֖וֹ שָׁ֥ב מִמֶּ֑נִּי הִנְנִי֙ נִשְׁפָּ֣ט אוֹתָ֔ךְ עַל־ אָמְרֵ֖ךְ לֹ֥א חָטָֽאתִי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mə·rî kî niq·qê·ṯî ’aḵ ’ap·pōw šāḇ mim·men·nî hin·nî niš·pāṭ ’ō·w·ṯāḵ ‘al- ’ā·mə·rêḵ lō ḥā·ṭā·ṯî
verses.literal: you say . . . I am innocent Surely His anger will turn from me Behold I will judge you because you say I have not sinned

verses.original: מַה־ תֵּזְלִ֥י מְאֹ֖ד לְשַׁנּ֣וֹת אֶת־ דַּרְכֵּ֑ךְ גַּ֤ם תֵּב֔וֹשִׁי מִמִּצְרַ֙יִם֙ כַּאֲשֶׁר־ בֹּ֖שְׁתְּ מֵאַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: mah- tê·zə·lî mə·’ōḏ lə·šan·nō·wṯ ’eṯ- dar·kêḵ gam tê·ḇō·wō·šî mim·miṣ·ra·yim ka·’ă·šer- bō·šət mê·’aš·šūr
verses.literal: How impulsive you are constantly changing - your ways . . . You will be disappointed by Egypt just as you [were] by Assyria

verses.original: גַּ֣ם מֵאֵ֥ת תֵּֽצְאִ֔י זֶה֙ וְיָדַ֖יִךְ עַל־ רֹאשֵׁ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ יְהֹוָה֙ מָאַ֤ס בְּמִבְטַחַ֔יִךְ וְלֹ֥א תַצְלִ֖יחִי לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: gam mê·’êṯ tê·ṣə·’î zeh wə·yā·ḏa·yiḵ ‘al- rō·šêḵ kî- Yah·weh mā·’as bə·miḇ·ṭa·ḥa·yiḵ wə·lō ṯaṣ·lî·ḥî lā·hem
verses.literal: Moreover . . . you will leave that place with your hands on your head for the LORD has rejected those you trust you will not prosper by their help
